name: Free Darshanam
timing: Morning Slot: 06:00 AM – 01:00 PM, Evening Slot: 04:00 PM – 08:00 PM
description: Free and direct entry. Chilkur Balaji Temple does not host paid Arjitha Sevas, quick darshan tickets, or online booking slots. The temple operates on a strictly non-commercial basis to treat all devotees equally.

name: 11 Wish-Making Pradakshinam (Sankalpa)
timing: Available during all open Darshan hours (5:00 AM – 1:00 PM & 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM)
description: Perform 11 pradakshinas (circumambulations) around the outer path to make your wish.

name: 108 Thanksgiving Pradakshinam (Krithagnatha)
timing: Recommended during early morning hours (5:00 AM – 7:30 AM) to avoid peak heat and crowds
description: Perform 108 pradakshinas barefoot once your wish is successfully fulfilled.

name: Amma Vari Darshanam
description: Free and open to all devotees inside the main complex to visit Sri Rajya Lakshmi Ammavaru.
